_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no macro print inside 24h, flat 24h tape, funding near flat, and fear_greed stuck ~30 keep the score inside Denial without a visible breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Denial phase; analyst explicit HOLD-forward, narrative silent/measured only (no opposing direction)
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 32-38, BTC range-bound, funding near flat, fear_greed high-20s to mid-30s
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed <20 with funding negative (drop to Panic) or fear_greed back to 40s on ETF inflows (lift to Anxiety)
